$comment: better-auth plugins that are removed at fork but are still constructed today.
Not an allowlist. #6 (`feat/p0-remove-inherited-surfaces`) removes all four. All four are
now gone: anonymous, device-authorization and bearer as of 2026-09-07, and `organization`
as of the S10 retrofit stage (issue #6) unmounting it. This list shrinks with the work:
better-auth-plugin-list.test.ts fails on an entry that is already gone, so the line must be
deleted in the same change -- which is why this array is empty rather than deleted
outright: the mechanism stays live for whatever gets condemned next. Any *other* condemned
or unrecognised plugin appearing in the constructed list fails immediately -- one wildcard
mount hides dozens of endpoints, and this assertion is the only thing that sees them.
